layouts.guidance: Reinforce corridor-bound, fire-avoidant progress along the left edge by starting at the top-left region and maintaining column 0 descent before turning toward the goal.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Emphasizes sticking to the left-edge corridor to avoid interior fires and wall pitfalls, aligning with Cluster A failure mode.
layouts.rationale: Exercises left-edge corridor adherence with hazards near the left edge and top row to reinforce safe, corridor-aligned routing.

layouts.guidance: Reinforce corridor-bound, fire-avoidant progress along the top edge by starting near the top-left region, staying on row 0, then descending toward the goal column when safe.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Emphasizes staying on the top-edge boundary to minimize exposure to central fires, aligning with Cluster B failure mode.
layouts.rationale: Exercises top-edge corridor adherence despite top-row hazards, reducing unnecessary interior exploration.
